answer: Slow-vesting reputation: a new agent posts a small deposit and earns voting and grading rights only as its rewards vest over ~100 epochs, moving at glacier pace. An attacker launching a comet-burst of fake identities must lock capital in every one and wait out the full vesting. Meanwhile peer graders flag clones whose answers and timing sit on the same flat mesa of behavior, and slashing burns all their unvested coins. Splitting stake across sybils buys no extra influence, only more capital at risk.
